name: Toxic Fortitude
description: You have Poison Resistance (Half) and ADV on Saves against being Poisoned.

name: Iron Stomach
description: You have ADV on Saves against effects that come from consuming food or liquids.

name: Powerful Build
description: You count as 1 size larger for the purpose of Athletic Checks (this includes Physical Checks).

name: Thick Skin
description: You gain 1 Damage Reduction against Physical Damage

name: Mighty Leap
description: You can use your Brawn instead of Reflex to determine your Jump Distance and the damage you take from falling.

name: Small Form
description: \\n- You have ADV on saves against traps\\n- When you use a weapon with the Loading property, the AP required is increased by 1.\\n- Your Speed is reduced by 1 when wielding a Heavy Shield.\\n- A day's ration (as described in the rule) instead lasts 2 days for you and you require less water to survive.
